description: A loan calculator for the monthly payment, and how much of it is interest. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

amount.description: The principal borrowed, in whatever currency you are working in. Every figure in the answer is in the same units.

rate.description: Nominal annual interest rate as a percentage, so 5.5 means 5.5% a year. 0 is a real case: an interest-free loan repaid in equal instalments.

years.description: Length of the loan in years. Fractions are allowed and rounded to whole months, so 2.5 is 30 monthly payments.

name: loan_calculator
title: Loan Calculator
